correctness.rationale: The hereditary finite recurrence enumerates every valid source/transform pair. The substring-equality overlap test exactly detects all new overlaps; absence of cubes makes the curling number the square-suffix indicator plus one. Both an all-label C++ enumerator and a Python symmetry-normalized enumerator independently return 6048 terminal words, two transforms of lengths 84 differing only at the last digit, exact fibers 4032/2016, 2016 extendable parents each with all 3 last letters and last digits in ratio 2:1, and no word at length 85. Replayed sources and finite counts are stored in the research package.

value.rationale: The naturally defined transform image of all maximum-length doubly overlap-free ternary words has an unexpected complete classification: 6048 sources collapse to two images sharing 83 digits, and every 83-letter parent has full three-letter branching with a rigid square-ending pattern. This is significant structural information about the extremal family, not the already-known size-6048 census or an arbitrary numerical slice.
